events.verdict: Marshall (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Green's (HOU) drive.
Thompson (DAL) and Thompson (HOU) reach for the rebound and there is incidental arm contact between the two players.
Thompson (HOU) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Doncic (DAL). Any ensuing contact is incidental.
Brooks (HOU) and Thompson (DAL) reach for the rebound and there is incidental arm contact between the two players.
Washington (DAL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Brooks (HOU) briefly grasps Doncic's (DAL) arm as he extends it towards him and the contact is marginal.
VanVleet (HOU) reaches in and initiates illegal contact to Doncic's (DAL) arm.
Green (HOU) legally contests Thompson's (DAL) jump shot attempt.

events.verdict: Irving (DAL) attempts to save the ball from going out of bounds by throwing it into the backcourt and Thompson (DAL) makes contact with the ball as he is stepping out of bounds.
Irving (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position defending Brooks' (HOU) drive to the basket and shot attempt.

Marshall (DAL) commits a take foul on Brooks (HOU).
Grimes (DAL) commits a take foul on Green (HOU).
